title: Technology and Engineering Agency Recruiter
description:
VTRAC Consulting Corporation

Intelligent Resources


Thank you for applying to VTRAC opportunities. Please e-mail your resume as an MS-WORD document in confidence, Subject: Technology and Engineering Agency Recruiters. Attention:


Positions: 2, Intermediate and Junior (Remote, Colombia, Brazil)

Working hours: Eastern Times (12 pm to 9 pm EST) or (8:30 to 5:30 pm EST)

Position Type: Permanent (Base Salary + Bonus + Paid Vacation)

Locations: 100% Remote (Colombia, Barranquilla, Santa Marta), São Paulo (Brazil)


ABOUT VTRAC

VTRAC Consulting Corporation ( is a well-established recruitment and consulting firm founded in 1993 by senior technology and business professionals. With a strong track record across North America, VTRAC delivers high-quality talent and consulting solutions in Technology, Engineering, and Management disciplines. As a majority women-owned business and certified diversity supplier, we are committed to building inclusive, high-performing teams.


At VTRAC, our people are our greatest asset. We foster a collaborative, energetic environment focused on teamwork, quality, and long-term relationships. We offer meaningful growth opportunities, where your ideas are valued, your contributions are recognized, and your personal and professional development is supported through competitive rewards and a strong team culture.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identify, engage, and explore candidates’ real motivation and interest, validate their skills and competencies, and present quality talents promptly.
  • In-depth technical and functional evaluation and assessment of technology candidates.
  • Participate in full-cycle recruitment and staffing assignments for both contract and permanent placement opportunities, for clients in the Technology, Engineering, automotive, and Finance sectors.
  • Network, research databases, contact, source, collect, screen applications, select, examine, evaluate, and interview candidates.
  • Coordinate and notify candidates on requirements for the prospective position, job offers, contracts, terms, and conditions of employment.
  • Partner and collaborate with other recruiters through teamwork, imparting your knowledge, experience, skills, and advice on staffing policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate the presentation of candidates to prospective clients.
  • Prepare reporting on activities and results.


QUALIFICATION

  • Min 2+ years of recruitment experience with a strong network, preferably in the technology or engineering, and familiar with Microsoft, Cloud Computing, Data, AI, FinTech, advanced mobility, UAV and manufacturing environment.
  • Min one year of experience in DIRECT HEADHUNTING of permanent and contract technology candidates.
  • MUST HAVE one year of experience as an agency recruiter working directly with the hiring clients (NOT through RPO).
  • Min one year of sales or sales support experience
  • MUST HAVE minimum 1 year working with U.S. or Canadian markets.
  • Must have technical evaluation experience and be able to assess the candidate’s skills.
  • VERY STRONG networking, relationship-building, and very active recruitment-related social media engagement activities, especially on LinkedIn.
  • Fluent English communication skills (verbal and written).
  • STRONG teamwork, time management, and organizational skills.
  • Working experience with MS Word, CRM, or ATS systems.

We thank all candidates in advance. Only selected candidates for interviews will be contacted. For other exciting opportunities, please visit us at VTRAC is an equal-opportunity employer.


Toronto. Houston. New York. Palo Alto.

title: Analista de Dados Digitais (Tracking & Analytics)
description:
Sobre a THREAD


A THREAD é uma consultoria de tecnologia e engenharia de software que cresce de forma consistente, impulsionada pela entrega contínua de valor e pela confiança de grandes marcas.


Somos especialistas em desenvolver sistemas sob medida, conectando estratégia, dados e performance em cada solução.


Atuamos em parceria com empresas de diversos setores, entregando produtos digitais, integrações e plataformas que unem tecnologia à estratégia de negócio.


Descrição da vaga


Buscamos um Analista de Dados Digitais (Tracking & Analytics) para atuar 100% remoto, apoiando a estruturação, coleta e análise de dados em produtos digitais de clientes.


Você será responsável por garantir que os dados capturados reflitam corretamente o comportamento do usuário, apoiando decisões de produto, marketing e negócio.


Esperamos alguém organizado, analítico e com forte capacidade de execução, que consiga transformar necessidades de negócio em estruturas de tracking claras, confiáveis e escaláveis.


Responsabilidades


  • Estruturar e manter mapas de tags (tracking plan)
  • Realizar tagueamento via Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento na criação e validação de variáveis e eventos
  • Garantir a qualidade e consistência dos dados coletados
  • Criar e evoluir relatórios de acompanhamento no Looker Studio
  • Validar implementações de tracking (debug, testes e QA)
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times técnicos e de produto para entender necessidades de mensuração
  • Documentar regras de tracking e estrutura de eventos
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria na coleta e uso de dados


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência com Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • Experiência com Google Analytics (GA4)
  • Conhecimento em estruturação de tracking (eventos, variáveis, dataLayer)
  • Experiência com Looker Studio (criação de dashboards)
  • Capacidade de estruturar mapas de mensuração (tracking plan)
  • Boa comunicação para interação com times técnicos (devs)
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a dados
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes
  • Capacidade de validar e garantir qualidade dos dados


Diferenciais


  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Qlik
  • Noções de HTML/CSS/JavaScript
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Hotjar, Firebase, etc.
  • Conhecimento em funil de conversão e métricas digitais
  • Experiência com testes A/B
  • Vivência em produtos digitais ou squads de tecnologia


Mindset esperado


  • Clareza e objetividade na comunicação
  • Forte senso de responsabilidade com dados e entregas
  • Organização e disciplina operacional
  • Autonomia para executar e destravar demandas
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com times técnicos
  • Foco em qualidade e confiabilidade da informação
  • Mentalidade analítica e orientada a impacto

title: SDR (Brasil)
description:
SDR & Client Acquisition Specialist, Remote | Part-Time R$1,500 – R$2,000/month + performance bonuses (potential to grow to full-time)


We're a UK-based performance marketing agency working with aesthetics and beauty clinics. We're looking for a confident, organised SDR to both work inbound leads for our clients AND help us grow the agency through outbound prospecting.


What You'll Do:

  • Call inbound leads quickly after submission and book them into consultations
  • Follow up with warm and cold leads consistently
  • Qualify prospects and handle objections professionally
  • Reach out to potential new clients for the agency via cold calls, DMs and email
  • Log all activity in the CRM and keep pipelines clean and accurate
  • Work closely with the marketing team and report daily on results


What We're Looking For:

  • Strong spoken English — clear, professional, and confident
  • Comfortable making high volumes of calls
  • Experience with cold calling and CRM systems (GoHighLevel preferred)
  • Organised, reliable, and hungry to grow
  • Proactive by nature — you don't wait to be told what to do
  • Someone who takes full ownership of their results — no excuses
  • Willing to learn, improve, and take feedback seriously


This is NOT for you if:

  • You need constant hand-holding
  • You make excuses instead of making calls
  • You're looking for something easy and low-effort
  • You avoid accountability when things don't go your way


This IS for you if:

  • You're self-driven and take initiative
  • You own your results — good and bad
  • You're hungry to learn and grow with a team
  • You want a role where performance is actually rewarded


Bonus Points:

  • Experience with UK or US clients
  • Background in high-ticket services or consultation booking
  • Familiarity with marketing funnels and CRM automations


Compensation & Growth:

  • Base: R$1,500 – R$2,000/month (part-time)
  • Performance bonuses for strong results
  • Real opportunity to grow into a full-time role for the right person

Hard workers who take ownership get rewarded here. If that's you — apply below.


To apply: send a 60-second voice note in English introducing yourself and why you're the right person for this role.

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Us: At Joveo, we are on a mission to deliver a job for everyone. As the global leader in programmatic job advertising, our Data Science team operates like a hybrid of a librarian and a Swiss army knife—leveraging gargantuan data sets and cutting-edge AI to match the right talent to the right roles.


The Role (TL;DR): We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our cross-functional pods. You will build and deploy state-of-the-art NLP models (like SentenceBERT) and predictive algorithms to optimize job embeddings, occupation classification, and applicant forecasting.


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and fine-tune language-agnostic embedding models to process millions of job postings.
  • Work with transfer learning models and predictive techniques (XGBoost, gradient boosting) to lower Cost-Per-Applicant (CPA) for our clients.
  • Partner directly with Product Managers and Software Engineers in decentralized, semi-autonomous pods to push code into production.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI/ML to eliminate bias in recruitment advertising.


What You Bring:

  • Proven experience in building machine learning models, specifically in NLP and predictive analytics.
  • Proficiency in Python and relevant libraries (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Gensim).
  • Experience with big data frameworks and deploying models into cloud environments.
  • A \"can-do\" mindset and a passion for solving complex, real-world problems.


Why Joveo?

  • Impact: Your code will directly help millions of people find jobs.
  • Flexibility: Remote-first culture with flexible working hours.
  • Growth: Generous learning and development budgets.

title: Líder técnico
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional altamente especializado(a) em Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), com atuação técnica e estratégica, para liderar a arquitetura, sustentação e evolução da plataforma. Esta posição terá papel central na definição de padrões, governança e boas práticas, além de apoiar squads técnicas e áreas de negócio na construção de soluções escaláveis, seguras e performáticas dentro do ecossistema Adobe Experience Cloud.


Responsabilidades

Definir, documentar e evoluir a arquitetura da plataforma AEM, incluindo modelagem de dados, estrutura de conteúdo e integrações

Administrar e manter a infraestrutura do AEM, incluindo Dispatcher (CDN), ambientes, pipelines CI/CD e configurações por runmodes

Executar e supervisionar rotinas avançadas de manutenção do repositório (Oak), garantindo performance e estabilidade

Atuar em troubleshooting avançado, analisando logs, dumps e ferramentas de monitoramento para resolução de incidentes críticos

Conduzir code reviews e garantir aderência às boas práticas de desenvolvimento e arquitetura AEM

Arquitetar e governar soluções de conteúdo, incluindo Templates, Content Fragments, Experience Fragments e MSM

Configurar e manter integrações com Adobe Experience Cloud e sistemas externos (APIs, CRMs, ERPs)

Gerenciar segurança da plataforma, incluindo controle de acessos, políticas e auditorias

Produzir documentação técnica e conduzir discussões de arquitetura com times internos

Apoiar tecnicamente equipes de marketing e desenvolvimento, além de atuar em treinamentos e onboarding


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais

Domínio avançado de Adobe Experience Manager (AEM 6.x / AEMaaCS), incluindo Sites, Assets, MSM e arquitetura OSGi/Sling/JCR

Experiência com infraestrutura AEM, incluindo Dispatcher, CI/CD, ambientes e configurações de segurança

Conhecimento avançado em administração do Oak (Tar Compaction, Datastore GC, índices)

Experiência em troubleshooting com análise de logs, thread dumps e ferramentas de monitoramento

Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento back-end AEM (Java, HTL, Sling Models, APIs REST, OSGi Services)

Conhecimento em arquitetura de conteúdo e modelagem JCR

Experiência com integrações Adobe Experience Cloud (Target, Analytics, Campaign, Commerce)

Vivência com segurança de aplicações (ACLs, CUGs, CORS, auditorias)


Diferenciais (Desejável)

Certificação Adobe (ACE – AEM Sites Developer ou Architect)

Experiência com AEM as a Cloud Service e Cloud Manager

Conhecimento em arquiteturas headless/composable e Edge Delivery Services

Experiência com migração de conteúdo em larga escala

Vivência com provedores cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)

Conhecimento em otimização de performance (Core Web Vitals)

Inglês avançado para interação com times internacionais


Informações Adicionais

Atuação: 100% remota

Contrato: PJ + benefícios

Remuneração: mensal fixa

Notebook (caso necessário)

Descanso remunerado de 14 dias

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,200 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Manager who will drive revenue growth by optimizing conversion rates, improving user experience, and reducing friction across the customer journey on their Shopify storefront. You will oversee and execute A/B testing, user behavior analyses, funnel audits, and UX gap analyses. You will have the knowledge and experience to use CRO reports, experiment results, and dashboards to identify areas for optimization and will lead projects to implement those findings. You will conduct competitive research and deploy the latest developments in conversion rate optimization in partnership with their development and ecommerce teams.


Essential Functions

  • A/B Testing and Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across key pages and touchpoints. Prioritize experiments based on potential impact, traffic, and business goals to build a rigorous, data-driven testing roadmap.
  • On-Site Optimization: Optimize landing pages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, cart, and checkout flows to maximize conversion. Collaborate with their ecommerce and design teams to ensure all pages are aligned with CRO best practices.
  • User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable hypotheses.
  • Shopify & Development Collaboration: Partner closely with their development team to implement CRO changes on the Shopify platform. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently.
  • Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Provide regular reports on CRO performance, experiment results, and KPIs using analytics and CRO tools. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Other duties may be assigned


What you will bring / Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • In-depth knowledge of CRO principles, UX best practices, and e-commerce conversion frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design.
  • Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform; ability to collaborate effectively with development teams on implementation.
  • Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports.
  • Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership.
  • Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations.
  • Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses.
  • Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics.


Education and/or experience

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce.
  • 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team.


Core competencies

  • Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and challenges with urgency and energy.
  • Resourcefulness: Securing and deploying resources effectively.
  • Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
  • Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities.
  • Strategic Thinking: Identifying opportunities and adapting to trends.
  • Technical Proficiency & Problem Solving: Using tools and data to drive solutions.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven: Focused on measurable, data-driven outcomes.


Benefits

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth by optimizing user experience and conversion performance.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Reliability
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Reliability

Location: Remote- LATAM


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience in platform reliability, backend systems, and cloud infrastructure. This role focuses on improving the reliability, scalability, and performance of a large-scale consumer video streaming platform.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and enhance highly reliable, scalable, and self-healing systems
  • Build and maintain observability (monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting)
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system performance and architecture
  • Define and maintain SLAs/SLOs for backend services
  • Troubleshoot production issues and drive long-term solutions
  • Act as SME for platform reliability across streaming systems

Required Skills:

  • Strong coding experience in Golang and JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Expertise in microservices and distributed systems
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, and Linux systems
  • Knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, load balancing)
  • Experience with observability tools (Datadog, OpenTelemetry)

Good to Have:

  • Experience with eBPF
  • Knowledge of video streaming (HLS, transcoding, playback)

title: Senior Digital Analytics Engineer
description:
Company Description

In 1995, Acronym created a digital marketing revolution by innovating a futuristic model of the marketing agency. Since then, we’ve forged a lasting path of success helping our Clients achieve their business goals.

Acronym. Our name signifies our deep understanding of both our Clients’ and industries lexicon. For our Clients, it means an independent performance marketing agency with the flexibility to find solutions for any need, turning insights into action and action into results. We are headquartered in the iconic Empire State Building, with a presence across EMEA and APAC.


Role Description

The Remote Senior Digital Analytics Engineer will join our Analytics & Optimization team. This team member will be instrumental in implementing and maintaining sophisticated digital analytics solutions for our clients, ensuring a robust data foundation that drives strategic business decisions. You will leverage your deep technical expertise and understanding of business objectives to guide clients on best practices and implement cutting-edge tracking strategies. This role will also have the opportunity to explore and implement emerging technologies, including AI-powered tools, to enhance data collection and efficiency over time. Some of the solutions this team member will be working with on a regular basis include Adobe Launch, Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Tealium iQ. 


This is the job…


·      Providing strategic guidance on data collection architecture and implementation strategies for web, app, and marketing technology solutions, acting as a technical leader on client engagements. 

·      Ensuring that all data collection and implementation efforts are aligned with client business objectives and contribute to the delivery of accurate and actionable insights that drive measurable results.

·      Working directly with technical stakeholders to answer questions, and help troubleshoot issues.

·      Creating technical documentation for our clients on how to best implement various web analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Adobe Analytics, as well as other marketing technologies.

·      Expertly configuring tag management systems (e.g., Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, Tealium iQ), analytics platforms (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics) and various third-party tracking pixels (Meta, LinkedIn, etc) based on sound data collection principles and industry best practices, as part of a comprehensive data collection strategy.

title: Especialista Governança de IA
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Especialista Governança de IA Sênior – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 30 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Especialista Governança de IA . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Experiência com governança, processos ou estruturação de frameworks corporativos de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento prático em IA generativa e LLMs;
  • Experiência com Gemini Enterprise (Google);
  • Conhecimento em GCP / ecossistema Google;
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e políticas de governança de IA;
  • Experiência com automação e desenvolvimento de scripts para suporte a processos;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma conceitual e técnica (do desenho à execução);
  • Experiência em interação com áreas corporativas (TI, Segurança, Jurídico, Dados).


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Experiência prévia com governança de IA, Responsible AI ou AI Risk;
  • Experiência com automação de processos utilizando IA;
  • Conhecimento em compliance, LGPD ou segurança da informação aplicada a IA.


Responsabilidades:


  • Estruturar e implementar frameworks de governança de IA aplicáveis a diferentes casos de uso na organização;
  • Definir políticas, processos e diretrizes para uso de IA generativa e ferramentas corporativas de IA;
  • Apoiar a organização na adoção segura e escalável de IA, garantindo alinhamento com boas práticas, compliance e segurança;
  • Atuar na governança do uso de Gemini Enterprise, definindo padrões de uso, controles e boas práticas;
  • Desenvolver scripts, automações e workflows utilizando Gemini e ferramentas associadas para operacionalizar processos de governança;
  • Mapear e organizar casos de uso de IA, definindo critérios de aprovação, uso e monitoramento;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas como Segurança, Jurídico, Dados, TI e Negócio para garantir alinhamento e aderência às diretrizes;
  • Apoiar na definição de controles, rastreabilidade e monitoramento do uso de IA;
  • Traduzir conceitos técnicos de IA em diretrizes claras para uso corporativo.

title: Desenvolvedor Front-end Pleno (Next.js + React)
description:
Sobre a THREAD


A THREAD é uma consultoria de tecnologia e engenharia de software que cresce de forma consistente, impulsionada pela entrega contínua de valor e pela confiança de grandes marcas.


Somos especialistas em desenvolver sistemas sob medida, projetados para unir estratégia, dados e performance em cada solução.


Atuamos em parceria com empresas de diversos setores corporativos, entregando produtos digitais, integrações e plataformas que conectam tecnologia à estratégia de negócio.


Descrição da vaga


Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Front-end Pleno (Next.js + React) para atuar 100% remoto na squad de sustentação e evolução de produtos digitais para um cliente do setor financeiro e automotivo.


Você fará parte de um time técnico, experiente e orientado à performance, garantindo estabilidade, correções estruturais e evoluções de front-end com qualidade THREAD.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir interfaces usando Next.js e React , com foco em performance, organização e escalabilidade.
  • Estruturar e gerenciar estado global da aplicação com Redux ou Redux Toolkit .
  • Criar componentes reutilizáveis e estilos escaláveis com SASS/SCSS .
  • Trabalhar com rotas, renderização e organização de páginas em aplicações Next.js .
  • Garantir qualidade de código, padrões de desenvolvimento e versionamento consistente.
  • Corrigir bugs, aprimorar telas existentes e implementar melhorias contínuas.
  • Integrar front-end com APIs REST de forma robusta e organizada.
  • Colaborar com backend, UX e produto em demandas de sustentação e evolução.
  • Analisar e resolver problemas com impacto em produção, com visão técnica e responsabilidade.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • 3+ anos de experiência com React
  • Experiência prática com Next.js
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript
  • Domínio de Zustand ou Redux Toolkit
  • SASS/SCSS avançado
  • Integração sólida com APIs REST
  • Git
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com legados modernos e organizar código existente
  • Boa leitura técnica e autonomia para resolver problemas sem depender de microgestão


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)


  • Conhecimento em SSR, SSG e boas práticas de performance no Next.js
  • Testes com Jest, React Testing Library ou Cypress
  • Storybook
  • Conhecimento de design systems
  • Experiência com aplicações responsivas e foco em usabilidade
  • Noções de SEO técnico em aplicações front-end


Mindset esperado


  • Clareza e objetividade na comunicação
  • Comprometimento absoluto com as entregas de backlog
  • Responsabilidade real em cumprir o combinado na planning
  • Organização e disciplina para manter previsibilidade
  • Autonomia para resolver problemas sem depender de microgestão
  • Capacidade de leitura de contexto e diagnóstico rápido
  • Postura colaborativa, madura e orientada a impacto
  • Foco em simplicidade, qualidade e execução consistente

description:
Sobre a THREAD


A THREAD é uma consultoria de tecnologia e engenharia de software que cresce de forma consistente, impulsionada pela entrega contínua de valor e pela confiança de grandes marcas.


Somos especialistas em desenvolver sistemas sob medida, projetados para unir estratégia, dados e performance em cada solução.


Atuamos em parceria com empresas de diversos setores corporativos, entregando produtos digitais, integrações e plataformas que conectam tecnologia à estratégia de negócio.


Descrição da vaga


Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Front-end Pleno (Next.js + React) para atuar 100% remoto na squad de sustentação e evolução de produtos digitais para um cliente do setor financeiro e automotivo.


Você fará parte de um time técnico, experiente e orientado à performance, garantindo estabilidade, correções estruturais e evoluções de front-end com qualidade THREAD.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir interfaces usando Next.js e React , com foco em performance, organização e escalabilidade.
  • Estruturar e gerenciar estado global da aplicação com Redux ou Redux Toolkit .
  • Criar componentes reutilizáveis e estilos escaláveis com SASS/SCSS .
  • Trabalhar com rotas, renderização e organização de páginas em aplicações Next.js .
  • Garantir qualidade de código, padrões de desenvolvimento e versionamento consistente.
  • Corrigir bugs, aprimorar telas existentes e implementar melhorias contínuas.
  • Integrar front-end com APIs REST de forma robusta e organizada.
  • Colaborar com backend, UX e produto em demandas de sustentação e evolução.
  • Analisar e resolver problemas com impacto em produção, com visão técnica e responsabilidade.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • 3+ anos de experiência com React
  • Experiência prática com Next.js
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript
  • Domínio de Zustand ou Redux Toolkit
  • SASS/SCSS avançado
  • Integração sólida com APIs REST
  • Git
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com legados modernos e organizar código existente
  • Boa leitura técnica e autonomia para resolver problemas sem depender de microgestão


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)


  • Conhecimento em SSR, SSG e boas práticas de performance no Next.js
  • Testes com Jest, React Testing Library ou Cypress
  • Storybook
  • Conhecimento de design systems
  • Experiência com aplicações responsivas e foco em usabilidade
  • Noções de SEO técnico em aplicações front-end


Mindset esperado


  • Clareza e objetividade na comunicação
  • Comprometimento absoluto com as entregas de backlog
  • Responsabilidade real em cumprir o combinado na planning
  • Organização e disciplina para manter previsibilidade
  • Autonomia para resolver problemas sem depender de microgestão
  • Capacidade de leitura de contexto e diagnóstico rápido
  • Postura colaborativa, madura e orientada a impacto
  • Foco em simplicidade, qualidade e execução consistente

title: Analista de marketing digital
description:
Localização: Remoto

Tipo de contratação: Tempo integral


Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Marketing Digital para atuar no suporte à execução e ao acompanhamento de iniciativas em canais digitais.


Esta posição é voltada para profissionais que já possuem familiaridade com rotinas de marketing digital e desejam desenvolver sua atuação em um ambiente estruturado, com foco em organização, consistência e melhoria contínua. O(a) profissional irá contribuir para a execução das campanhas, acompanhamento de desempenho e organização das atividades relacionadas às iniciativas digitais.


Responsabilidades

Executar e acompanhar campanhas de marketing digital em diferentes canais.

Monitorar métricas de desempenho e manter a organização das informações.

Analisar dados para identificar oportunidades de otimização e ajustes.

Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e no acompanhamento de resultados.

Organizar atividades e fluxos de trabalho relacionados às campanhas.

Colaborar com a equipe para garantir a consistência das iniciativas.

Seguir processos internos e boas práticas de marketing digital.


Requisitos

Experiência ou conhecimento em marketing digital.

Familiaridade com campanhas online e canais digitais.

Boa capacidade de organização e atenção aos detalhes.

Perfil analítico e interesse em trabalhar com dados.

Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração em equipe.


Ambiente de trabalho

Modelo remoto com rotinas estruturadas.

Processos definidos e suporte interno.

Ambiente colaborativo, profissional e orientado a melhoria contínua.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) ServiceNow Sênior - Especialista ITOM
description:
Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar e configurar módulos de ITOM: Discovery, Event Management, Orchestration, Service Mapping, Cloud Management.
  • Integrar ServiceNow com ferramentas de monitoramento (ex: Zabbix, SolarWinds, Dynatrace, Splunk).
  • Desenvolver e manter scripts, workflows e automações utilizando Flow Designer e Script Includes.
  • Realizar análise de causa raiz e correlação de eventos para melhoria e correção de erros da operação.
  • Garantir a visibilidade de ativos e serviços críticos por meio de CMDB e Service Mapping.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de infraestrutura, segurança e desenvolvimento para garantir a eficácia das soluções.
  • Participar de projetos de transformação digital e automação de processos operacionais.

Requisitos:

  • Formação Superior Completo.
  • Experiência com ServiceNow, especialmente nos módulos de ITOM.
  • Conhecimento avançado em CMDB, CI Classes, relacionamentos e normalização de dados.
  • Domínio de JavaScript para desenvolvimento na plataforma.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e integração via APIs REST/SOAP.
  • Certificações desejáveis:
  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – ITOM
  • ServiceNow System Administrator
  • ITIL Foundation


Contratação: CLT FULL + Benefícios + Plano de Carreiras

Atendimento: 100% Remoto

title: Analista de Folha de Pagamento Sênior (APDATA)
description:
#Vemparaotimeloungerie


Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa que quer romper tabus, preconceitos, barreiras e padrões


Essa é a Loungerie!


Estamos em busca de uma Analista de Folha de Pagamento Sênior com sólido conhecimento no sistema APDATA , para tuar de forma estratégica na gestão da folha de pagamento, garantindo compliance, precisão nos processos e suporte às áreas do negócio.


Responsabilidades


• Liderar o ciclo completo de fechamento da folha de pagamento, incluindo parametrizações e regras no sistema Apdata;

• Garantir a correta aplicação das Convenções Coletivas (CCTs) para lojas e matriz;

• Realizar a transmissão e auditoria de eventos no eSocial (tabelas, periódicos e não periódicos);

• Gerar e acompanhar a DCTFWeb, assegurando conformidade com obrigações legais;

• Apurar e conferir encargos: INSS, FGTS (Digital), IRRF e contribuições sindicais;

• Realizar conciliações entre folha, contábil e financeiro, incluindo provisões (férias e 13º);

• Atuar na análise de notas fiscais de prestadores de serviço (PJs);

• Apoiar auditorias e processos trabalhistas, organizando evidências e propondo melhorias;

• Atender gestores e colaboradores em dúvidas relacionadas à folha, legislação e processos.


Requisitos


• Experiência sólida com folha de pagamento e encargos;

• Domínio do sistema Apdata (com foco em parametrização e integrações);

• Conhecimento aprofundado da legislação trabalhista (CLT) e regras de retenção;

• Excel avançado (PROCV, Tabela Dinâmica e desejável Macros);

• Ensino superior completo em Administração, RH, Contabilidade ou Direito;

• Pós-graduação será um diferencial.


Competências comportamentais


• Visão analítica e sistêmica;

• Comunicação clara e didática;

• Resiliência e equilíbrio emocional;

• Senso de dono e responsabilidade pelos resultados.


Benefícios


• Local: Berrini – Zona Sul/SP

• Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido

• Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação

• Assistência Médica e Odontológica

• Seguro de Vida

• Desconto em produtos da marca

• Day Off no aniversário

• Gympass e Zenklub

• Médico na Tela (telemedicina)

title: Endpoint System Engineer (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an Endpoint System Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Endpoint Systems Engineer is responsible for managing and supporting endpoint platforms and tooling across customer environments within the Managed Services organization. This role focuses on endpoint management, patching, monitoring, and automation using centralized management tools. Endpoint Systems Engineers ensure endpoint health, compliance, and performance through proactive monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of tooling and processes.This role combines technical troubleshooting with platform ownership and automation, working closely with internal teams and customer stakeholders to maintain stable, secure, and well-managed endpoint environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Own the health, performance, and compliance of endpoint environments across customer environments.
  • Manage and maintain endpoint management platforms (MDM/RMM), including Intune and NinjaOne.
  • Monitor and maintain endpoint health, patching, and compliance, ensuring successful deployment and remediation of OS and application updates.
  • Investigate and resolve endpoint-related issues, including performance, configuration, and policy enforcement problems.
  • Create and manage problem investigations for recurring or complex endpoint issues.
  • Develop, test, and maintain scripts and automation (PowerShell preferred) to support endpoint management and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain integrations between endpoint management tools and other systems (e.g., ITSM, monitoring platforms).
  • Collaborate with infrastructure and support teams to resolve cross-system issues impacting endpoints.
  • Maintain endpoint configuration standards, policies, and documentation.
  • Participate in change management processes for endpoint-related updates and deployments.
  • Identify and implement improvements to endpoint management, automation, and operational processes.


Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • 3–6 years of experience supporting endpoint management in an MSP, enterprise IT, or similar environment.
  • Experience with endpoint management platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune, other MDM solutions).
  • Experience with RMM tools (e.g., NinjaOne or similar platforms).
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 / Entra ID device management.
  • Experience with Windows endpoint administration and lifecycle management.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills related to endpoint systems.
  • Experience with patch management processes and tools.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.).
  • Experience working within ticketing systems and structured support processes.
  • Strong scripting skills (PowerShell preferred) for automation and tooling.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Certifications such as Microsoft, endpoint management, or cloud certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Deep experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies, including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD).

title: Talent Recruiter LATAM
description:
Job Title: Talent Recruiter (Influencers)

Company: DolFinContent LLC

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full Time (Contractor)


About DolFinContent

DolFinContent LLC is a talent agency specializing in influencers, representing digital creators worldwide and connecting them with brands through strategic partnerships, sponsorships, and campaign opportunities. The agency focuses on long-term creator growth, brand alignment, and professional representation within the creator economy.


Position Overview

DolFinContent is seeking a Talent Recruiter to support the continued expansion of the agency’s influencer roster. This role focuses on identifying high-potential creators, conducting professional outreach, managing onboarding, and supporting talent relationship development. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and passionate about social media, creator partnerships, and talent development.


Key Responsibilities

• Identify, source, and recruit influencers and digital creators across major social media platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Twitch, Kick, and emerging platforms

• Conduct professional outreach through social media platforms, email communication, and networking tools

• Manage the onboarding process for new creators, including agreements, internal documentation, and profile setup

• Build and maintain strong professional relationships with creators through consistent communication

• Maintain accurate internal databases, including talent rosters, creator profiles, and recruitment pipelines

• Research social media trends and identify emerging creators with strong growth potential

• Collaborate with Talent and Sales teams to support campaign opportunities and roster growth

• Track recruitment activity, outreach performance, and talent acquisition metrics

• Provide weekly recruitment reports and progress updates

• Support general talent operations and recruitment initiatives as needed


Skills and Qualifications

• Native or fluent English proficiency (written and verbal) is required

• Excellent organizational and time management abilities

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities

• Interest in influencer marketing, talent management, recruiting, or digital media

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment

• Experience with Google Sheets, Excel, CRM systems, or outreach tools is preferred

• Previous experience in recruiting, talent sourcing, or influencer marketing is a plus


Compensation

• Base compensation of 1,000 USD per month

• Commission opportunities based on creators successfully recruited and onboarded

• Performance-based earning potential with growth opportunities


What We Offer

• Direct experience within the influencer marketing and talent management industry

• Opportunity to work with a growing global talent agency

• Professional development within talent acquisition and creator partnerships

• Remote work environment

• Performance-based growth opportunities


How to Apply

If you are passionate about social media, talent discovery, and relationship building, we encourage you to apply and join DolFinContent’s growing global team.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Joveo:

Every company says they're \"AI-first.\" We actually are. Joveo's recruitment

advertising platform processes millions of hiring decisions through machine

learning, real-time bidding, and predictive analytics — helping the world's

largest employers find the right people, faster and fairer. But we're not

done. Not even close.


Role Overview:

We are hiring a Software Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable

software systems that power our global recruitment advertising infrastructure.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ship high-quality,

production-grade code across the full development lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities:

- Design, develop, and maintain backend and/or frontend software systems

- Write clean, tested, and well-documented code aligned with team standards

- Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical decisions

- Debug and resolve production issues with speed and precision

- Collaborate with product, design, and data teams in agile sprint cycles

- Conduct and participate in code reviews to maintain engineering quality


Required Skills & Qualifications:

- Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go, JavaScript)

- Experience building and maintaining scalable, distributed systems

- Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design

- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

- Experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines

- Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative engineering mindset


Equal Opportunity Employer:

Joveo is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an

inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all qualified individuals

regardless of race, color, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity

or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, marital status,

or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All hiring decisions

are made solely on the basis of qualifications, skills, and demonstrated

ability.


If your dream job is one that doesn't fit neatly into a job title — apply.

Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (AWS, PySpark, Airflow)


Employment Type: independant contractor

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Business Model & Pricing (BMP) Analytics team. In this role, you will design and build scalable data systems that power analytics, reporting, and AI/ML initiatives across the organization.

You will work closely with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure reliable, high-quality data is available to drive strategic decisions.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines using SQL, Python, and PySpark
  • Develop and optimize data models and data warehouse solutions (Snowflake, data lake)
  • Implement and manage workflow orchestration using Airflow
  • Build and support data infrastructure on AWS
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and reliability across systems
  • Collaborate with analytics and business teams to deliver data-driven solutions
  • Support AI/ML initiatives by enabling data pipelines and MLOps workflows
  • Contribute to data products and applications (e.g., Streamlit dashboards, chatbot integrations)
  • Drive best practices in data engineering, automation, and performance optimization

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering or Data Platform development
  • Strong hands-on experience with SQL and Python
  • Experience with PySpark / Spark (big data processing)
  • Hands-on experience with Airflow or similar orchestration tools
  • Strong experience with AWS (S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift, etc.)
  • Experience with data warehousing (Snowflake or similar)
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT, and data architecture
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with data lake architectures and hybrid environments
  • Exposure to MLOps and machine learning pipelines
  • Experience with Streamlit or data applications
  • Familiarity with chatbots or conversational data interfaces
  • Experience working in global or matrix organizations
  • Contributions to documentation platforms (Confluence, etc.)

title: Video Editor - Remote (Short-Form Ads)
description:
Video Editor & Graphic Designer


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips
  • Edit short-form content optimized for platform-specific formats
  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Job Title: Business Development Representative

Company: DolFinContent LLC

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full Time (Contractor)


About DolFinContent

DolFinContent LLC is a talent agency specializing in influencers, representing digital creators worldwide and connecting them with brands through strategic partnerships, sponsorships, and campaign opportunities. The agency focuses on long-term creator growth, brand alignment, and professional representation within the creator economy.


Position Overview

DolFinContent is seeking a Business Development Representative to support the continued expansion of the agency’s influencer roster. This role focuses on identifying high-potential creators, conducting professional outreach, managing onboarding, and supporting talent relationship development. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and passionate about social media, creator partnerships, and talent development.


Key Responsibilities

• Identify, source, and recruit influencers and digital creators across major social media platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Twitch, Kick, and emerging platforms

• Conduct professional outreach through social media platforms, email communication, and networking tools

• Manage the onboarding process for new creators, including agreements, internal documentation, and profile setup

• Build and maintain strong professional relationships with creators through consistent communication

• Maintain accurate internal databases, including talent rosters, creator profiles, and recruitment pipelines

• Research social media trends and identify emerging creators with strong growth potential

• Collaborate with Talent and Sales teams to support campaign opportunities and roster growth

• Track recruitment activity, outreach performance, and talent acquisition metrics

• Provide weekly recruitment reports and progress updates

• Support general talent operations and recruitment initiatives as needed


Skills and Qualifications

• Native or fluent English proficiency (written and verbal) is required

• Excellent organizational and time management abilities

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities

• Interest in influencer marketing, talent management, recruiting, or digital media

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment

• Experience with Google Sheets, Excel, CRM systems, or outreach tools is preferred

• Previous experience in recruiting, talent sourcing, or influencer marketing is a plus


Compensation

• Base compensation of 1,000 USD per month

• Commission opportunities based on creators successfully recruited and onboarded

• Performance-based earning potential with growth opportunities


What We Offer

• Direct experience within the influencer marketing and talent management industry

• Opportunity to work with a growing global talent agency

• Professional development within talent acquisition and creator partnerships

• Remote work environment

• Performance-based growth opportunities


How to Apply

If you are passionate about social media, talent discovery, and relationship building, we encourage you to apply and join DolFinContent’s growing global team.

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining customer IT infrastructure within the Managed Services environment. This role focuses on resolving technical issues, supporting backend infrastructure systems, and collaborating with customer IT teams to deploy and maintain solutions. Infrastructure Engineers combine technical troubleshooting with proactive monitoring and documentation to ensure stable and secure client environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to servers, virtualization, storage, and core infrastructure systems.
  • Serve as an escalation point for the IT Support team on complex infrastructure-related incidents.
  • Work directly with customers and their IT teams to support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of infrastructure solutions.
  • Investigate alerts and system reports to proactively identify potential infrastructure issues and performance risks.
  • Follow established runbooks, procedures, and architectural documentation to resolve incidents.
  • Exercise sound technical judgment when diagnosing and resolving infrastructure issues that may not have predefined solutions.
  • Assist with the creation and maintenance of runbooks, diagrams, and infrastructure documentation.
  • Participate in system maintenance activities such as upgrades, patching, and system health checks.
  • Document incident resolution steps and system changes within internal ticketing and knowledge management systems.
  • Maintain strong communication with internal teams and customers regarding issue status and resolution timelines.



Requirements

  • 8+ years of IT experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • 3–6 years of experience supporting IT infrastructure in an MSP, enterprise IT, or hosting environment.
  • Experience with Windows or Linux server administration.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.).
  • Familiarity with storage, backup, and disaster recovery systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Experience working within ticketing systems and following structured support processes.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD).
  • Cloud platform administration experience; Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) are preferred.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including infrastructure design, administration, and troubleshooting.
  • Administration experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), and enterprise storage platforms.
  • Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

title: Account Executive
description:
Job Description


Full Time

Remote: Latin America

Rate: 4.000 USD


About Company

Company is a global brand protection platform that helps companies detect and remove counterfeit products across marketplaces, social media, and search engines.

Our technology identifies infringing listings, collects legally valid evidence, and coordinates takedowns at scale — protecting brands, consumers, and intellectual property online.

Counterfeiting is a $500B+ global problem, and companies are increasingly investing in solutions that protect their brand reputation, revenue, and customers.

We work with companies that need real protection against digital counterfeiting, and our sales team plays a critical role in helping organizations understand the scale of the problem and the value of solving it.


The Role

We’re looking for a high-performing Account Executive who is obsessed with closing deals.

At Company , this role is not about managing accounts. This role is about turning qualified pipeline into revenue.


What You’ll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle from Discovery to Close
  • Lead discovery calls and qualify opportunities
  • Identify and map the full buying committee within target organizations
  • Deliver tailored product demos to stakeholders
  • Build business cases around brand protection, legal risk, and revenue protection
  • Negotiate commercial terms and contracts
  • Manage pipeline inside the CRM and maintain deal momentum
  • Work closely with internal teams to ensure successful deal execution
  • Consistently meet or exceed quarterly revenue targets


Requirements (Non-negotiable)

  • Fluent spoken and written Spanish & English
  • 3–6+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales
  • Proven experience closing $20K+ contracts
  • Strong discovery and qualification skills
  • Experience managing multi-stakeholder buying processes
  • Comfortable presenting and negotiating with senior decision-makers
  • Highly organized pipeline management
  • Strong ownership of revenue outcomes


Strong Pluses

  • Experience selling LegalTech, Compliance, Risk, or Brand Protection solutions
  • Experience selling to legal teams, brand protection teams, or compliance departments
  • Experience selling to U.S. companies
  • Previous experience in early-stage startups
  • Experience managing enterprise sales cycles


This Role is NOT for You If

  • You expect inbound leads to do the work
  • You are uncomfortable leading discovery conversations
  • You struggle navigating complex buying processes
  • You prefer account management over closing deals
  • You are not motivated by revenue targets


This Role IS for You If

  • You consider yourself elite at closing deals
  • You enjoy selling complex solutions to senior stakeholders
  • You thrive in high-performance environments
  • You are motivated by commission and performance
  • You want to build a strong enterprise sales career in SaaS

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Now Hiring | PS Project Coordinator

Location: Remote (LATAM – Brazil / Colombia)

Duration: 12+ Months

Rate: $13 USD/hour


About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Project Coordinator to support Professional Services (PS) project delivery in a fast-paced, global environment.

This role will focus on project coordination, scheduling, communication, and reporting , ensuring smooth execution from kickoff through completion.


Required Skills

  • Fluent in Spanish and English (Portuguese is a plus).
  • Strong communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation).
  • Excellent organizational and time management abilities .
  • Experience with:
  • Spreadsheets and project management tools
  • Task tracking and prioritization
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and timelines .
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy .
  • Experience with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive) .
  • Background supporting technical or IT-related projects .

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business , or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2–3 years of experience in Project Coordination or Project Management .


If you’re highly organized, proactive, and enjoy keeping projects on track, this is a great opportunity to grow your career in project coordination

title: Analista de Governança de Dados Sênior
description:
Você acredita que dados de qualidade são o alicerce para uma IA de sucesso? Sabe que governança não é burocracia, mas sim eficiência e confiança?


Na redspark , estamos em busca de um perfil sênior para transformar nossos instrumentos de governança em ferramentas vivas. Sua missão será garantir a integridade, a padronização e a rastreabilidade das informações que alimentam nossas maiores inovações.


Seu papel no time:

  • Operacionalizar o Catálogo e Metadados: Implementar e gerir o catálogo para que datasets críticos sejam facilmente encontrados e compreendidos.
  • Gestão do Glossário: Ser a ponte que padroniza os termos de negócio entre diferentes sistemas.
  • Data Quality na veia: Implementar regras de qualidade, monitorar métricas e apoiar o tratamento de inconsistências.
  • Mestria em Dados (MDM): Apoiar a estruturação de fontes autoritativas e dados mestres.
  • Linhagem e Transparência: Garantir a documentação e a rastreabilidade total da informação (da origem ao consumo).
  • Guardião da Padronização: Auxiliar na organização de datasets prontos para Analytics e IA.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Lead Data Engineer

Requirements:

  • ETL/ELT Development: Proficiency in Python scripting and dbt to build and maintain modular data transformation pipelines.
  • Cloud Data Warehousing: Experience with Amazon Redshift , including SQL development and basic performance tuning
  • Workflow Orchestration: Ability to develop and monitor Apache Airflow DAGs to ensure reliable task scheduling.
  • AWS Managed Services: Familiarity with AWS Glue , S3, and the broader AWS ecosystem for serverless data processing.
  • Logic Translation: Capability to adapt Informatica ETL logic or similar legacy tool patterns into modern code-based workflows.
  • Engineering Standards: Solid understanding of Git version control and data modeling fundamentals.

title: Chief Revenue Officer
description:
Chief Revenue Officer


The Opportunity


We're looking for a seasoned Chief Revenue Officer to help our client — an AI-powered logistics SaaS company — build and scale their US enterprise revenue engine from the ground up.


Our client is a Houston-based, seed-funded logistics platform founded in 2019. They bring consumer-app simplicity to enterprise logistics, unifying appointment scheduling, dock and yard management, and gate digitization for shippers, 3PLs, and carriers.


They've built real product-market traction and are now ready to scale. That's where you come in.


The Role


Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own the entire US enterprise revenue motion end-to-end — strategy, hiring, pipeline, forecasting, and expansion. This is a rare \"own the whole thing\" seat: you'll set GTM strategy, build the team, and personally drive early pipeline until that team is in place.


What You'll Do


  • Build and execute the US enterprise GTM strategy from scratch
  • Hire, onboard, and lead the full revenue organization — AEs, BDRs, and sales management
  • Personally carry and close strategic early enterprise deals while the team ramps
  • Own pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue operations
  • Partner with the CEO on pricing, packaging, and market positioning
  • Establish the sales culture, process, and playbook for a company scaling from near-zero to multi-million in ARR



What We're Looking For


Required:


  • 15–20 years of revenue leadership experience at the CRO level
  • Demonstrated track record scaling revenue from near-zero to multi-million within US enterprise
  • Proven experience hiring, building, and leading revenue teams (AEs, BDRs, sales managers) — not a solo operator with a CRO title
  • Deep logistics or supply chain industry experience
  • Native-level English and executive-level presence
  • Willingness to provide 2–3 references from prior employers


You'll thrive in this role if you:


  • Have reference-able revenue numbers you can point to from prior companies
  • Are energized by building from scratch rather than managing a mature org
  • Can toggle fluidly between strategy, recruiting, and rolling up your sleeves to close deals
  • Have operated inside or sold into US enterprise logistics, freight, or supply chain


This is not the right fit if you:

  • Come from a mid-market or non-logistics SaaS background
  • Have primarily tactical experience (AE, sales manager) without true org leadership
  • Lead with CRM/pipeline theater rather than produced revenue
  • Have never built or managed a revenue team

description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer – GCP & Snowflake (BigQuery, Python, Airflow)

Location: Mexico/ Brazil / Costa Rica (Remote)

Type: Contract / FTE


Summary:

Looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong experience in BigQuery, Snowflake, Python, and Airflow/Composer to support, stabilize, and scale data pipelines. The role includes managing Snowflake workflows, operating migrated BigQuery pipelines, and integrating international logic into global data platforms for scalability and standardization across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake environments.


Key Skills:

BigQuery, Snowflake, Python, SQL, Airflow/Composer, ETL/ELT, GitHub, CI/CD, Data Warehousing (Star Schema, Dimensional Modeling, OLTP vs OLAP)


Responsibilities:

Support existing Snowflake workflows; Operate and stabilize BigQuery pipelines; Integrate international/Paramount logic into global pipelines; Design and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines across AWS, GCP, Snowflake; Implement data quality checks and reconciliation; Optimize performance and cost (BigQuery/Snowflake); Manage workflows and CI/CD; Maintain documentation


Experience:

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field; 12–15 years overall IT experience; 7–9 years in data engineering


Nice to Have:

Adobe Analytics; Experience with global data standardization; Strong DevOps practices

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Solutions Architect – Sao Paulo / Hybrid - Fluent French & English

(Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, Software Implementation, Solutions Architecture, SaaS, Architecture, API Integrations, REST, Web Services, CRM, eCommerce, ERP, OMS, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant)


Our client is an exciting and cutting-edge fintech giant with a global presence. They have been a market leader within the fintech consultancy sector for many years and their worldwide client base has never been stronger, with significant growth in the last 12 months. They are looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to own the end-to-end solution design, implement their cloud-based space planning and design platforms and ensure solution integrity from discovery through deployment.


As an experienced Solutions Architect, you will be responsible for providing architectural oversight across multiple concurrent implementations and leading architectural discovery sessions with customer stakeholders. This will include designing end-to-end solution architectures across SaaS platforms, APIs, middleware, CRM, eCommerce, and Order Management systems.


Expert knowledge of cloud-based SaaS architecture and API integrations, such as REST and Web Services is essential, as experience leading enterprise-level software implementations. Experience working in multi-system ecosystems, such as CRM, eCommerce, ERP and OMS is also expected. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills are a must, as you will be acting as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers and presenting solution designs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will also need to have excellent time and priority management skills that enable you to work in different time zones and speak and write fluently in French and English.


We are keen to hear from talented Solutions Architect candidates from all backgrounds.


This is a truly amazing opportunity to work for a prestigious brand that will do wonders for your career. They invest heavily in training and career development; top performers are guaranteed a career path into senior and lead positions within 12 months.


Location: Sao Paulo / Hybrid

Salary: 160k BRL – 190k BRL + Bonus + Pension + Excellent Benefits

Languages: Fluent in French and English


To apply for this position please send your CV to Karan Gajjar at Noir Consulting.

We are looking for an experienced software developer to join our LATAM Solutions team and help us build the next generation of our innovative product, customizing solutions using cutting edge AI/ ML technologies.


Job Functions :

● Create and implement new solutions for existing and / or new IRM customers

● Participate and collaborate in technical projects and architectural review

● Collaborate / lead technical discussions with internal teams

● Work with several internal teams, have a good relationship

● Develop, test and implement new code

● Identify, resolve and when needed escalate any roadblock encountered that will impact project success.


Skills :

● Experienced python developer

● Knowledge with web / react / Python / java coding languages

● Knowledge with API integration

● Knowledge on AI and ML technologies.

● Ability to craft LLM prompts to enhance automation and customer experiences

● Knowledge in Google Cloud, , Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)

● Team player

● Good communication skills

● Able to communicate in English (writing, reading and speaking) - At minimum, intermediate level

title: DevOps - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: DevOps - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

Obrigatório

  • Conhecimentos básicos em Linux (terminal, análise de logs e processos)
  • Lógica de programação e/ou scripting (Python, Bash ou similar)
  • Noções de Git (clone, commit, pull request)
  • Conceitos iniciais de automação e infraestrutura como código
  • Conhecimento conceitual sobre containers e Kubernetes/OpenShift
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de arquivos YAML





O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Driven Platforms)

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with strong experience designing, building, and scaling modern web applications and SaaS platforms. In this role, you will work across the entire stack, from intuitive frontend interfaces to robust backend services, cloud infrastructure, and AI-powered solutions. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, and platform teams to deliver high-impact, scalable systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and scale full-stack web applications and SaaS platforms
  • Build high-quality, maintainable frontend experiences using modern frameworks
  • Develop APIs and backend services with a focus on performance, security, and scalability
  • Architect and manage cloud-native infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code
  • Implement AI-powered features using foundation models and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures
  • Ensure reliability through automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and observability best practices
  • Collaborate in English on a daily basis with cross-functional and international teams

Technical Requirements

Frontend

  • Strong experience with TypeScript, React, and Next.js
  • Proficiency with modern CSS frameworks such as Tailwind CSS

Backend

  • Solid experience with Node.js (Express and/or NestJS) and/or Python (FastAPI or Django)

Databases

  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or AWS Aurora
  • Experience with Vector Data Stores (Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, pgvector, or Pinecone)

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Deep familiarity with AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, API Gateway) or GCP
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or AWS CDK)

AI & Orchestration

  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock (working with foundation models like Claude or Llama)
  • Experience with Google Vertex AI
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and RAG architectures

DevOps & CI/CD

  • Experience with Docker and GitLab CI
  • Strong knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, AWS CloudWatch, Google Cloud Monitoring, and Google Cloud Logging

Testing

  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Jest, PyTest, Playwright, or Cypress

Developer Tools

  • Advanced proficiency with AI coding assistants such as Cursor, GitLab Duo, and Claude Code

Language Requirements

  • Advanced English proficiency for daily communication


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.
